utility.notes: SCE's own 'Incorporated Cities and Counties Served by SCE' fact sheet (updated 3/17/2025) explicitly lists 'Garden Grove' by name among the cities in its service area.

value.name: Southern California Edison (SCE)
value.notes: Orange County Power Authority (OCPA), the only CCA operating in Orange County, directly re-verified this session as serving exactly four member cities — Buena Park, Fullerton, Irvine, and Fountain Valley (now live, having previously been 'beginning service soon') — via its own homepage's 'Celebrating our member communities' listing. Garden Grove is not among them, so SCE is recorded as both the distribution and generation utility.

county.notes: Garden Grove is a well-documented Orange County city; also listed under Orange County in SCE's own service-area fact sheet.

permit_authority.value: City of Garden Grove Community Development Department, Building Division

interconnection_url.notes: SCE's own Net Energy Metering (NEM) program page — a utility-wide fact already established for other SCE-territory records this session. The city's own guidelines separately instruct applicants to 'Notify serving utility before activation of PV system.'

value.name: California SGIP - current category and budget check required
value.description: New applications and waitlist applications for ratepayer-funded SGIP budgets closed on December 30, 2025. New AB 209 applications have a June 30, 2028 deadline. The 2026 SGIP rate table publishes $3.10/W for solar and $1.10/Wh for storage in applicable Residential Solar and Storage Equity categories. Household eligibility and live budget availability vary by category and program administrator; check the official Program Metrics tracker before relying on an incentive.
value.eligibility: Eligibility varies by 2026 SGIP budget category, program administrator, property, income/pathway, project rules, and live funding availability.

battery_programs.notes: SGIP program data refreshed on 2026-08-26 from the official 2026 Handbook and live Program Metrics. Earlier locality records contained 2025 opening/availability language. This record does not assert household eligibility, reservation availability, or a guaranteed incentive; current category and program-administrator status must be checked before reliance.

value.name: 2 sets of plans, minimum sheet size 11"x17"
Manufacturer specification sheets, installation instructions, and U.L. listings attached to plans
Plans signed by a State of California contractor (classification A, B, C-46, or C-10) or licensed electrical engineer, with signature and license number on each sheet
Roof plan, electrical drawings, single-line diagram, inverter/module/array specifications, and system calculations per the city's detailed technical checklist

value: Contact the building inspection request line at (855) 380-8758, or schedule electronically at https://ch.ci.garden-grove.ca.us/permitsoft/inspections/new
Inspection requests received up to 4:00pm are scheduled for the following business working day; requests received after 4:00pm are scheduled for the second business working day
The inspector verifies conformance with applicable code requirements and the approved plans

timeline_days.notes: The document details plan-check content requirements and inspection scheduling but does not itself state a specific number of days for plan-review completion or permit issuance.

value.program_or_pathway: Expedited permitting for small residential rooftop solar energy systems (photovoltaic or solar domestic water heating), over single- or two-family dwellings
other_conditions: Must complete the city's Eligibility Checklist and meet all criteria to qualify for expedited permitting
Framing information and structural calculations are waived if arrays are supported at a maximum spacing of 4 feet
Lateral analysis is waived if total array area is less than half the total roof area and module+support weight is 4 psf or less
Notify the serving utility before activation of the PV system
